scope: 1000 Claims, 2 history steps, 4 Claims/write, 8 orphan proposals, attached disposable Git workspace; 3 writes per process, 2 repeated samples per arm/run. Uncontrolled system load; not p95. Order before/after/after-final/before-final. No stable end-to-end improvement established.
exploratory_after_note: First after run used uncommitted implementation; final commit differs only in citation cache default budget, raised from 64 to 128 MiB. Neither budget is approached by this 1000-Claim direct-capture workload. Final after report records the committed head.

before.head: 5a8ab4fcedb89c8c5dcb856f9e05cb11fe4f3aed
before.policy_workload: Original empty ClaimType admission policies and varying seed/history values.
before.scope: SDK claim draft/prepare/submit/status; HTTP approval challenge/sign/submit; SDK accept; coordinate-pinned HTTP full Claim readback; explicit SDK refresh (fresh typed World snapshot when world=true). Half of each batch revises seed Claim identities; remainder creates observations. Attached Git workspace; no floor or mirror. See server_profile for instrumentation. Cold means fresh daemon process, after separately timed SDK connect/orient; warm loops advance the accepted coordinate. Disk caches are uncontrolled.
